description: Use this when the user asks how to get full (non-preview) DC Hub data center results. Returns the access options with links for the user to open. If this call carries an API key or an MCP session, the checkout binds to it and your very next call returns full data (no reconnect); if it carries neither, the key is emailed to the payer instead — the response says which applies in `next_call_full_after_checkout` and `after_checkout`. Paid plans: on the page behind the human_url link. Want the FREE tier instead (no payment, previews plus 2 full answers per tool per day, 50/day with an email)? Call claim_free_key. A gated result already carries its link in human_url; that link is the one to share, and this tool returns the fuller ladder. Param: reason (optional — what you were trying to do, so your human sees why it matters). Returns {plans, human_message, what_unlocks}.
